projects.name: Jeemzu API
projects.description: A production ASP.NET Core 8 REST API powering a personal gaming leaderboard platform and personal chatbot. Features JWT authentication with refresh token rotation, per-game leaderboards with guest and authenticated score submissions, and a RAG-powered personal assistant chatbot backed by pgvector similarity search and the OpenAI API via Semantic Kernel.
highlights: Implemented a full RAG pipeline: personal info stored as structured JSON is chunked, embedded via OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, and stored in pgvector with an HNSW cosine distance index for fast semantic retrieval

Chat endpoint is stateless — client supplies conversation history each request, server embeds the question, retrieves top-K relevant chunks, injects them into the system prompt, and streams back a grounded answer from gpt-4o-mini
Deployed on Azure App Services with Azure PostgreSQL, auto-migrating schema on startup via Entity Framework Core
